identityWidth: The source identity is the hash of the set animationIdentities() records. The two weapon FBX files, the installed packages and the Vite configuration are outside it (review note N-04); the owner decided to keep it so (07-18-IDENTITY-WIDTH-DECISION.md, decision: keep).

calibration.note: Reference arm against a second materialised copy of the reference arm. A calibration has no candidate arm, qualifies nothing, adds no frozen evaluation and changed no tolerance: T_single stays 0.25 and T_aggregate 0.05. Figures are reported, never used to tune. Ratios are derived read-only from the two arm reports; the rule2 ratio is (c - q - eps) / r as section 4 defines, c/r is the plain quotient.

wording: passed, session 1 of 1; 0 valid sessions failed; 0 invalid
frozenEvaluationsOnEarlierSource: Not numbered in this list because they were made on different source (contract section 9): among them 135 statistics over on 2026-10-07 and a structural failure on 2026-10-09. They stay recorded where they are.

meaning.appliesTo: the sessions the verdict counts, always with the denominator: passed, session 1 of 1; 0 valid sessions failed; 0 invalid
meaning.means: in one software-rendered session on this host, in the offline Training Range workload, the five owner files as they are now did not cost more than the same five files at the freeze, within 5% typically and 25% in any single profile for the frame interval, and within about one timer tick for the small script components; and every structural check of the frozen gate still passed.
doesNotMean: That the original fixed limits were met. The recorded frozen evaluations failed them (plan 07-13: 40 of 192 over), and that stays recorded. A paired pass is never worded as meeting the original absolute limits.
Any frame-rate claim, any representative-device claim, or any human motion or quality acceptance. An agent's review is none of these either.

That Phase 7 as a whole did not add animation cost, or did not make the game slower. Cost that was present at the freeze, including the first-person view from plan 07-07, is in both arms and cancels. The first-person view cost is invisible to the paired predicate, and it is equally invisible to the frozen limits, which were also taken with that view present. Neither gate tells you what the view costs.
Anything about any file outside the five owner files. Their cost is identical in both arms.
Anything about online play, or about any workload other than offline Training Range with 1 and 8 source actors.
That the current owner files are as fast as they have been. They are compared with the pre-tuning owner files, so a later slowdown smaller than the tuning gain passes.
That sub-millisecond components did not regress by less than one timer step plus tolerance.
That zero limits still hold exactly.
Anything about a real GPU or another host. The sessions are software-rendered on one desktop.
That any earlier failed report has become a pass, or that a smoke or a calibration session is a qualification.
